stats-page.label-time-zone: Days follow the shop's time zone: {timeZone}.
stats-page.problem-invalid: Enter both days as real dates.
stats-page.problem-reversed: The first day must not be after the last.
stats-page.problem-too-long: The period can be at most two years.
stats-page.problem-too-many-buckets: That period has too many groups; choose a larger one.
stats-page.cancellation-detail: {cancelled} of {placed} orders placed in the period
stats-page.chart-failed: The chart could not be drawn. The table view holds the same numbers.
stats-page.product-sold-nothing: This product sold nothing in the period.
stats-page.note-sales: Every figure is net of VAT unless its title says otherwise. A sale is dated by when it was paid; a refund by when it was processed. An offline payment counts from the day it was recorded, not the day the money arrived. Shipping is exact for full refunds only: a partial credit note folds its shipping into goods.
stats-page.note-products: Reversals are units of returns received in the period; a cancellation has no date and is not counted.
stats-page.note-categories: A product in two categories counts in both, so the slices add up to more than the total.
stats-page.note-operations: The cancellation rate is a cohort: orders placed in the period that ended cancelled. Customers are matched by account only.
stats-page.note-product-sales: Orders deleted by an administrator drop out of the counts; the money on their invoices stays.
stats-page.note-limits: The pipeline cards are a snapshot of now, not of the period.
